The '''Muurshantre Extinction''' was an event that saw the destruction of the document known as the [[Taurannik Codex]],<ref name="Mindor" /> which the [[Death/Legends|death]] cult [[Knell of Muspilli]] from<ref name="TUR">''[[The Unknown Regions]]''</ref> the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> location [[Gunninga Gap/Legends|Gunninga Gap]] transcribed in order to summon apocalyptic [[Deity/Legends|deities]].<ref name="TUR" /> By the time of the [[Imperial Era/Legends|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] a hundred [[Millennium/Legends|millennia]] after the Muurshantre Extinction, scattered scraps of the Taurannik Codex were located among the [[moon tree]]s that drifted in the interstellar [[Realspace/Legends|space]] of the Gunninga Gap.<ref name="Mindor" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Muurshantre Extinction was mentioned in the [[2008]] novel ''[[Luke Skywalker and the Shadows of Mindor]]'' by [[Matthew Stover]].<ref name="Mindor" />
